assessment: This paper provides evidence that the environmental redox state shapes metabolic liabilities in pancreatic cancer cells. In vitro, pancreatic cancer cells rely on the malate-aspartate shuttle to regenerate oxidized electron acceptors in the cytosol that are required for cell proliferation; stromal cells within tumors secrete metabolites that serve as alternate electron acceptors, thereby reducing cancer cell reliance on the malate-aspartate shuttle.
